remarks: Look no further! If you're ready to stop renting and start investing, this is the perfect opportunity you've been waiting for. This bright and charming one-bedroom apartment is ideally situated just two blocks from beautiful Cove Island Park, offering easy access to the water and the beach-a great place to take a run or walk your dog. The unit is bright with natural light and features a good-sized bedroom and a flexible living space designed for both an Eat-In Kitchen and a comfortable living room, which flows seamlessly together, maximizing the usable space. This property also includes a dedicated storage unit in the basement for storing your things. This is a must-see for first-time buyers and investors looking for a great location where you are minutes to I-95, Chelsea Piers, Bus Access, and of course, some much-needed beach time when summer rolls around.
